question: Khajuraho was one of the capitals of which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Chandela Dynasty**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Khajuraho was an ancient city in Madhya Pradesh.

 
 
• It was the capital of the Chandelas from the 10th to 12th century.
 
• The majority of temples at Khajuraho are either Hindu (Saiva or Vaisnava) or Jain.
 
• Khajuraho is listed by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site.
 
• The temples at Khajuraho are famous for their erotic sculptures.
 
• They were built during the reign of the Chandela dynasty.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pratihara Dynasty****​**

 
 
• The Gurjara-Pratihara (Pratihara) was a dynasty that ruled much of Northern India from the mid-8th to the 11th century.
 
• They ruled first at Ujjain and later at Kannauj.
 
• The Gurjara Pratihara dynasty was founded by Harichandra.
 
• Nagabhata I was the first prominent ruler of Pratiharas.
 
• Mihira Bhoja was one of the most important rulers of the Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty. 
 
 
 
• **Pala Dynasty**
 
 
• Th**e Pala Dynasty i**s known for its contributions to the art, culture, and architecture of** Bengal and Bihar regions.**
 
• The dynasty's name **"Pala" means "protector" an**d was used as a suffix to the names of all Pala monarchs.
 
• **Dharmapala, one of the most prominent rulers of the Pala Dynast**y, was instrumental in establishing the Pala influence over northern India.
 
• The Pala period is **often regarded as a high point in the history of Bengal and Bihar, **marked by prosperity and cultural flourishing.
 
• The Pala rulers were also known for their military prowess and diplomatic relations with other regional powers.
 
 
 
• **Kalachuri Dynasty****​**
 
 
• The Kalchuri dynasty was formed by Kokalla(1st) in 845 AD ruled in the (7th-13th) century in the central region.
 
• He made Tripuri as its capital. At present, it is located in the Jabalpur district.
 
• He defeated the ruler of the Pratihara Dynasty Bhoj. They are also known as the Kalchuri of Chedi.
 
• The Kalchuri dynasty was the contemporary of Gurjara-Pratihara, Rashtrakuta, and the Chalukyas of Kalyani. 
 
• This dynasty reached its zenith under the ruler Lakshmikarna.
 
 

bf:T
